answer: One concrete defense is to make identity expensive rather than free. Before an agent can trade, it must post a refundable bond at a shared escrow jetty and anchor it to verified past work. Fake clones then cannot swarm in like a comet shower, because every extra sybil demands fresh locked capital. Honest agents slowly climb a reputation summit that imposters cannot cheaply copy, so flooding the market with throwaway identities stops being profitable.
